new.note: Vanilla cupcakes piled with red cream cheese frosting, a balloon string on each.
new.how: Heat the oven to 180C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar until pale, beat in 2 eggs, then fold in 185g self-raising flour, 125ml milk and 1 tsp vanilla. Fill the cases two thirds and bake 18 to 20 minutes until a skewer comes out clean, then cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 60g soft butter and 300g icing sugar, colour it bright red, pipe a tall swirl on each cake and push in a short length of string so each one looks like a balloon.

r2.make_ahead: Bake the day before, ice on the day

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C and line a muffin tin with 12 paper cases.
Beat 125g butter with the caster sugar until pale, beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour, milk and vanilla.
Fill the cases two thirds and bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the cakes on a rack.
Beat the cream cheese with the other 60g butter and the icing sugar, and colour it bright red.
Pipe a tall swirl on each cake and push in a short length of string like a balloon.
